by
  intro r
  split
  · intro hnz
    rw [nonZeroDivisors_iff_not_zeroDivisor]
    intro hz
    contraposn
    intro hz'
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz'
    rw [zeroDivisor_iff_exists_ne_zero_dvd]
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h1 : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ∣ (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) y :=
      QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_dvd_iff_dvd r y
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_dvd_iff] at h1
    cases h1
    · exact h1.1
    · exact h1.2
    contradiction
  · intro hnz
    rw [nonZeroDivisors_iff_not_zeroDivisor]
    intro hz
    contraposn
    intro hz'
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz'
    rw [zeroDivisor_iff_exists_ne_zero_dvd]
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h1 : r ∣ y :=
      QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_dvd_iff_dvd r y
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_dvd_iff] at h1
    cases h1
    · exact h1.1
    · exact h1.2
    contradiction
